ModMetaData.name: Peaceful Farewell
ModMetaData.author: Ghost
ModMetaData.description:
Lets colonists peacefully leave the colony instead of dying, vanishing or breaking down - always with your permission, through a letter you can accept or refuse. No DLC required.
- Visiting relations: when friendly visitors arrive with someone a colonist is close to (spouse, family, close friend), the colonist goes over to talk with them a few times during the visit. Depending on how those talks go, their bond, mood and the friends they'd leave behind, they may ask to leave and join that faction - or decide their place is here. - Loneliness: a colonist nobody in the colony likes may ask to leave and find somewhere they belong. - Wanderlust: a teenager may feel the urge to see the world and set out for a while. - Wanderers are tracked in the world: they may come back, settle with a faction (and send letters home), or never be heard from again. - Bonded animals leave together with their owner, colonists say goodbye to their room before leaving, and those left behind react to the departure.
Fully translated into English and Polish. Requires Harmony.
